title: Left Leaning Models: How AI Evaluates Economic Policy?

bias_targets.methodology: Conjoint experiment presenting LLMs with economic policy vignettes where seven macroeconomic and social variables (e.g., economic growth, inequality, inflation, unemployment) are randomly varied. The models rate their approval of the policies from 0 to 100, and OLS regression is used to extract the relative weight placed on each factor, identifying a preference for left-of-center policy priorities.
